discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to 216 (B016) and 424. 29 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked. New: FiGPiN Infinity War line (#110/#112, Jul 2018 ship), FiGPiN XL Thanos (year held), FiGPiN Mickey 90th, Marvel Skottie Young SDCC and NYCC 2018 series (most members held), Stance x shopDisney set. Released 424 holds on Gentle Giant 3.75in Stormtrooper/Han Solo/Chewbacca (per-style LE 1500). Funko, Primark, Cantina, FiGPiN Mini, Deadpool & Cable holds kept. Coco Faces Booster lead is a Disney Parks set, not Loungefly. BoxLunch-exclusive items left to B282.
